title: Pinolero
style: trap,  type, wavy psychedelic, confidente, 160 BPM halftime, airy ad libs, baritone lead vocal, pitched vocal layers, Fender Rhodes chords, subby 808 glide, muted electric guitar, detuned synth plucks, sparse trap snare, reverse piano lifts, tape saturation, spring reverb, wide stereo delay, vinyl warmth, bittersweet nostalgia
lyrics:
[Intro]
NC Argis… Pinolero desde la cuna…
Melodic trap… wavy…
[Verse 1]
Pinolero desde la cuna, NC Argis is the one booking shows
I want my words to shine bright inside your soul
Inside me death don’t scare me anymore
I move without fear when it’s garu and puca, that’s the code
In my senses the calm of Tupac purifies the mind, it blows your nuca
My voice papi, claro it never caduca
I spread my word like Lucas, I charge up or I see it felluca
In my party it’s pura reboluta
Life is good but sometimes it’s bruta
I can’t find the taste, nothing really suits me
I’m locked in, it’s all about conducta
Understand in San Juan something stays hidden
You listen to the same shit and it cultivates you
Cállate cállate if you don’t know what you’re saying
We line it up and throw all the cream
Bad fame but I do it out of pure sed
The energy of life, radiant with faith
[Chorus]
Madre y abuela, the example they gave
If I know about lyrics, claro I learned it from them
I don’t want millions just to press the luxury button
Voices in my mind, there’s a whole ovation
I’m always earning my life day by day
A pinch of passion on top of the escenario
For the music I already turned into a mercenario
Focus on your own shit, don’t build a calvario
[Verse 2]
Ooooo wowww doña armonía cura el corazón
I throw all the demons inside one song
I do it at all cost and with no condition
Every problem has a solution
Obviously I knew my music wouldn’t be to your liking
And with that I’m content, but I keep my ears well occupied
Enamorado of the way music expresses and impacts universes
I’m a whole anormal loco, I love what I do
I only sing for what I feel but i am life in black
I dream big, change the world, check ready, strength of Clark
Thanks to God today I still have a voice
There was confusion but family love resolved it
Enjoying what I have, I’m talking ‘bout San Juan
Fighting to do the impossible is what they’ll say
Waking up from every moment that flies by, you don’t even notice
I hope after this rola you go straight to hug mamá
Ouuu sheet, reventar un disco de lo que llega
Rafael y Argis, we give everything
Bailar with the broki wantanamera
Don’t close yourself inside a esfera
[Chorus]
Madre y abuela, the example they gave
If I know about lyrics, claro I learned it from them
I don’t want millions just to press the luxury button
Voices in my mind, there’s a whole ovation
I’m always earning my life day by day
A pinch of passion on top of the escenario
For the music I already turned into a mercenario
Focus on your own shit, don’t build a calvario
[Outro]
Doña armonía cura el corazón…
Los demonios los tiro en una song…
Pinolero desde la cuna…
NC Argis… melodic trap with soul…
Don’t close yourself in a esfera… go hug your mamá.
